brief:
Israeli occupation forces evacuated residents from a residential building in Tulkarm and converted the structure into a military barracks, the Ma'an news agency reported. The move represents another instance of property seizure in the West Bank city, where Israeli forces have increasingly commandeered civilian buildings for military use.

The takeover follows a pattern of residential confiscation across occupied Palestinian territories. The specific number of residents affected by the evacuation and the building's exact location within Tulkarm remained unclear from available reports.
title: Israeli forces evacuate residential building in Tulkarm, convert it to military barracks
